heterogeneity_flagged: TWO UNMAPPED issues, both keyed to the SAME named mechanism 'model-drift'. DRUG_RESISTANCE (canonical NEOCER[Hyper] 'cognitive forward model — model-drift', summary = accelerating antimicrobial resistance) and THERAPEUTIC_RELIABILITY_RISK (canonical CBLM[Hyper] 'forward-model error-correct — model-drift', summary = treatment inconsistency / evidence-to-care translation lag / quality variation). Model-drift is a PREDICTIVE-CODING / forward-model divergence: for DRUG_RESISTANCE it is an evolutionary arms-race (an adaptive adversary the model cannot keep pace with); for THERAPEUTIC_RELIABILITY_RISK it is calibration/reliability variance. The 9 Part XIV classes are all E/I-dynamics archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation); NONE expresses predictive-model drift, adaptation, or reliability variance. Marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit. THIS IS THE KEY MEDICINE FINDING: predictive-coding is a listed CRITICAL MECHANISM (Part XIII.5) but the Part XIV FAILURE taxonomy has no model-drift class — the same structural gap that left Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL unmapped, on a different axis (adaptation/calibration rather than deception).

MALPRACTICE_CRISIS — its DOMAIN framing ('systemic increase in medical errors, diagnostic failures... eroding public trust') is an information-integrity / error-reporting phenomenon adjacent to Finance's fraud archetype. UNLIKE fraud, however, its named NEURAL mechanism (canonical dACC[Hypo] 'conflict/error monitor — noise-chase') IS a genuine E/I archetype: a hypoactive error-monitoring brake that releases preventable harm = DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME. It therefore MAPS. Divergence between domain-content flavor (error-reporting) and named mechanism (brake-loss) recorded, resolved toward the mechanism cue.

CLINICAL_COORDINATION_BREAKDOWN — classed on its SUMMARY (fragmentation / referral leakage / interoperability gaps / handoff loss -> DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS). Its canonical NODE cue is THAL[Hypo] 'gating relay — stuck-closed=starvation' (= GATING_FAILURE), the SAME canonical cue as SUPPLY_SHORTAGE and CARE_ACCESS_FAILURE. Only the latter two are true starvation/GATING; the coordination issue is really disconnection across the graph. Node-cue vs summary divergence flagged, not resolved by guessing.

Medicine uses a BROADER slice of the taxonomy than Finance: EXCITOTOXICITY (PANDEMIC), CORTICAL_SPREADING_DEPRESSION (HEALTHCARE_COLLAPSE) and OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY (MENTAL_HEALTH_CRISIS) are all invoked here and were NOT used by Finance — consistent with Medicine being the domain whose failures are most literally physiological/dynamical.

INCOMPLETE-CIRCUIT result differs sharply from Finance. Finance passed 6/6; Medicine FAILS 4 of 10 (_authored circuits for HEALTHCARE_COLLAPSE, MENTAL_HEALTH_CRISIS, CHRONIC_DISEASE_LOAD, CLINICAL_COORDINATION_BREAKDOWN contain NO node from REGULATORY_NODES = their brake/feedback arm is omitted). Notably CHRONIC_DISEASE_LOAD's CANONICAL single-node circuit IS a regulatory node (HYPO) yet its _authored circuit drops HYPO -> _authored fails while canonical-only would pass (the inverse of Finance's MARKET_CRASH/SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION note).
_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Medicine-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test. Where the issue text names a mechanism with no analog among the 9 classes (model-drift), it is marked UNMAPPED.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

issue_failure_class_map._basis: GROUNDED: each mapping uses the Medicine issue's OWN text (canonical circuit detail and/or summary, quoted in medicine_text) plus the document's Part XIV named class. No new class was invented. Where the issue text names a mechanism with no analog among the 9 classes (model-drift), it is marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit.
issue_failure_class_map._classes_used: EXCITOTOXICITY, CORTICAL_SPREADING_DEPRESSION, DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (x2), GATING_FAILURE (x2), OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY, DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS — 6 distinct classes across the 8 grounded issues (Finance used 4).

PANDEMIC.subtype: sustained excessive drive with no termination -> overload -> burnout/death of the unit
PANDEMIC.medicine_text: canonical circuit BNST[Hyper]: "sustained threat monitor — tonic-stuck=burnout"; _authored OXY[Hyper-active]: "Nursing workforce stretched beyond safe limits with burnout and moral injury"; summary: "Rapid spread of novel infectious disease overwhelming healthcare capacity... simultaneously"
PANDEMIC.reasoning: The named canonical mechanism is a sustained-threat monitor 'tonic-stuck=burnout' — drive held ON with no termination until the unit overloads and dies (burnout). That is the EXCITOTOXICITY archetype (excessive drive + failed termination -> overload -> death), independently echoed by the _authored OXY node ('burnout and moral injury'). Clearance/termination is the violated invariant.
PANDEMIC.note: Straddles SEIZURE — the summary's 'rapid spread... overwhelming capacity' is a runaway-propagation flavor. Classed EXCITOTOXICITY on the dominant canonical node cue ('tonic-stuck=burnout' = overload-to-death, not convulsive runaway).

DRUG_RESISTANCE.reason: Issue text names a mechanism ('model-drift') with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
DRUG_RESISTANCE.medicine_text: canonical circuit NEOCER[Hyper]: "cognitive forward model — model-drift"; summary: "Accelerating antimicrobial resistance rendering standard treatments ineffective, threatening a return to pre-antibiotic mortality rates"; _authored HYPO[Hypo-active]: "Pharmaceutical pipeline failing to produce new antimicrobial agents at the rate resistance emerges"
DRUG_RESISTANCE.reasoning: 'Model-drift' in a forward model describes a PREDICTIVE-CODING divergence: the model of the pathogen falls out of calibration because the pathogen ADAPTS (an evolutionary arms-race against an adaptive adversary). The 9 Part XIV classes are dynamical E/I archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation); none expresses model-drift, adaptation, or an arms-race. Predictive coding is a listed CRITICAL MECHANISM (XIII.5) but has no FAILURE class in Part XIV. Forcing it into EXCITOTOXICITY on the secondary 'pipeline can't keep pace' clearance hint would over-reach past the named canonical mechanism. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
DRUG_RESISTANCE.note: One of the two KEY HETEROGENEITY findings. Same structural gap that left Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL unmapped, on a different axis (adaptation/model-drift rather than deception).

HEALTHCARE_COLLAPSE.medicine_text: canonical circuit DV[Hyper]: "dorsal motor vagus — parasympathetic output — dorsal-vagal shutdown/collapse"; summary: "Systemic failure of healthcare delivery from combined workforce shortages, financial insolvency, and infrastructure degradation"
HEALTHCARE_COLLAPSE.reasoning: The named canonical mechanism is 'dorsal-vagal shutdown/collapse' — the freeze/shutdown response in which the system depolarizes and then goes silent under overwhelm. That maps to CORTICAL_SPREADING_DEPRESSION (a slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm). The invariant violated is SLEEP_OFFLINE / homeostasis.
HEALTHCARE_COLLAPSE.note: Straddles NEURODEGENERATION — the summary's 'combined workforce shortages... infrastructure degradation' reads as compounding maintenance failure over time (NEURODEGENERATION = maintenance failure compounding -> network collapse). Classed CSD on the canonical node cue (acute shutdown-to-silence); NEURODEGENERATION divergence recorded. Its _authored circuit also FAILS the incomplete-circuit test (no regulatory partner).

MALPRACTICE_CRISIS.subtype: loss of the error-catching brake -> preventable harm released
MALPRACTICE_CRISIS.medicine_text: canonical circuit dACC[Hypo]: "conflict/error monitor — noise-chase"; _authored dACC[Hypo-active]: "Error detection systems failing to catch diagnostic mistakes before patient harm occurs"; summary: "Systemic increase in medical errors, diagnostic failures, and preventable harm eroding public trust"
MALPRACTICE_CRISIS.reasoning: A HYPOACTIVE conflict/error monitor is the loss of an inhibitory oversight function (the brake that catches mistakes). Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (here: preventable harm) = DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (loss of the stop/brake). The named neural mechanism is a genuine E/I archetype, so the issue maps.
MALPRACTICE_CRISIS.note: HETEROGENEITY FLAG: the issue's DOMAIN framing ('medical errors... eroding public trust') is an information-integrity / error-reporting phenomenon adjacent to Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL. UNLIKE fraud (fabricated content, no neural analog), Medicine's named mechanism here is a real hypoactive brake, so it grounds in DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME rather than going UNMAPPED. Divergence between content flavor (error-reporting) and mechanism (brake-loss) resolved toward the mechanism cue.

SUPPLY_SHORTAGE.medicine_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; summary: "Critical shortages of medications, devices, blood products, and protective equipment disrupting care delivery across all specialties"
SUPPLY_SHORTAGE.reasoning: The named mechanism is a routing gate 'stuck-closed=starvation': the throughput gate for supplies is shut and the downstream (all specialties) is starved. That is exactly the GATING_FAILURE archetype (gate stuck closed -> starvation). Strongest grounding of the set alongside CARE_ACCESS_FAILURE.

MENTAL_HEALTH_CRISIS.medicine_text: canonical circuit mPFC[Hyper]: "medial PFC — self-referential value integration (DMN core) — self-focus/rumination"; summary: "Escalating prevalence of depression, anxiety, PTSD, and suicidality overwhelming psychiatric capacity"
MENTAL_HEALTH_CRISIS.reasoning: The named canonical mechanism is a HYPERactive DMN core locked in 'self-focus/rumination' — pathological over-engagement / over-coupling of the default-mode network, the hypersynchrony pole of OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY (over-coupling degrades communication). The rumination-as-DMN-hyperconnectivity reading is the one carried elsewhere in this system.
MENTAL_HEALTH_CRISIS.note: Alternates: SEIZURE (a runaway recurrent self-excitatory loop the vmPFC brake fails to stop) and DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (failed extinction / PTSD, named in the summary). Classed OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY on the 'DMN-core hyperconnectivity/rumination' cue; alternates recorded. Its _authored circuit also FAILS the incomplete-circuit test (no regulatory partner).

CARE_ACCESS_FAILURE.medicine_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; summary: "Treatment access gaps, provider shortage, delayed care, geographic care deserts, and affordability-driven deferral collapsing patient access pathways"
CARE_ACCESS_FAILURE.reasoning: Same routing-gate 'stuck-closed=starvation' mechanism as SUPPLY_SHORTAGE: the access gate is shut and patients are starved of care. GATING_FAILURE (gate stuck closed -> starvation). The summary is squarely about STARVATION of access (patients cannot get in), which distinguishes it from CLINICAL_COORDINATION_BREAKDOWN (patients get in but are lost between nodes).
CARE_ACCESS_FAILURE.note: Shares the identical canonical THAL cue with SUPPLY_SHORTAGE and CLINICAL_COORDINATION_BREAKDOWN; only SUPPLY_SHORTAGE and CARE_ACCESS_FAILURE are true starvation/GATING (see CLINICAL_COORDINATION_BREAKDOWN).

CHRONIC_DISEASE_LOAD.medicine_text: canonical circuit HYPO[Hyper]: "homeostatic set-point — severed=runaway"; summary: "Rising metabolic burden, persistent cardiovascular strain, diabetes and obesity escalation creating sustained long-duration treatment demand"
CHRONIC_DISEASE_LOAD.reasoning: The named mechanism is a homeostatic set-point 'severed=runaway' — the negative-feedback brake is cut, so the load runs away with no stabilizer. Losing the stop/brake and releasing runaway activity is the DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME definition. Directly parallels Finance CURRENCY_COLLAPSE ('brake-fail=rogue'); here the cue names the feedback loop severed.
CHRONIC_DISEASE_LOAD.note: The canonical single-node circuit here IS a regulatory node (HYPO), yet the _authored circuit (BNST, CARD, mPFC, BDNF, ECN) DROPS HYPO and every other regulatory node -> _authored FAILS the incomplete-circuit test while canonical-only would pass. Inverse of Finance's MARKET_CRASH/SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION note; recorded in incomplete_circuit_diagnostic.

CLINICAL_COORDINATION_BREAKDOWN.subtype: cross-graph fragmentation / lost input -> the network is the unit of failure
CLINICAL_COORDINATION_BREAKDOWN.medicine_text: summary: "Fragmented care pathways, referral leakage, discharge failure, poor interoperability, and multi-provider coordination gaps disrupting continuity of care"; _authored details: "losing patients at handoff points between services", "results not reaching referring providers in time", "findings failing to propagate through fragmented clinical information systems"; canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"
CLINICAL_COORDINATION_BREAKDOWN.reasoning: The summary and _authored details describe DISCONNECTION across the care graph — inputs (results, referrals, patients) failing to propagate between connected nodes, continuity lost at handoffs. That is definitionally DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS (losing input disables distant connected regions; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure).
CLINICAL_COORDINATION_BREAKDOWN.note: Classed on the SUMMARY. The canonical NODE cue (THAL 'stuck-closed=starvation') points at GATING_FAILURE — the SAME cue SUPPLY_SHORTAGE and CARE_ACCESS_FAILURE use for true starvation. Here the governing phenomenon is fragmentation/disconnection, not starvation; node-cue vs summary divergence flagged, not resolved by guessing. Its _authored circuit also FAILS the incomplete-circuit test (no regulatory partner).

THERAPEUTIC_RELIABILITY_RISK.reason: Issue text names a mechanism ('model-drift') with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
THERAPEUTIC_RELIABILITY_RISK.medicine_text: canonical circuit CBLM[Hyper]: "forward-model error-correct — model-drift"; summary: "Treatment inconsistency, evidence-to-care translation lag, diagnostic uncertainty, trial-to-practice gap, and quality variation across clinical sites"
THERAPEUTIC_RELIABILITY_RISK.reasoning: 'Forward-model error-correct — model-drift' names a PREDICTIVE-CODING / calibration failure: the forward model drifts and treatment reliability varies across sites (a variance / consistency / QC problem). The 9 Part XIV classes are E/I-dynamics archetypes; none expresses model-drift or reliability variance. Predictive coding is a listed CRITICAL MECHANISM (XIII.5) but has no FAILURE class. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline rather than forced.
THERAPEUTIC_RELIABILITY_RISK.note: Second of the two KEY HETEROGENEITY findings — shares the 'model-drift' cue with DRUG_RESISTANCE. Here the axis is calibration/reliability variance (vs DRUG_RESISTANCE's adaptive arms-race). Both sit outside the E/I-dynamics taxonomy.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against medicine.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses _authored node list).
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: MIXED: 6/10 complete, 4/10 INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT. This DIFFERS SHARPLY from Finance (6/6 PASS) and Energy (6/6). Four Medicine issues (HEALTHCARE_COLLAPSE, MENTAL_HEALTH_CRISIS, CHRONIC_DISEASE_LOAD, CLINICAL_COORDINATION_BREAKDOWN) author multi-node circuits that contain NO node from REGULATORY_NODES — their inhibitory/feedback/homeostatic arm is omitted, so under Part XIV they are lesioned in the same way a brain is. Notably CHRONIC_DISEASE_LOAD's CANONICAL circuit IS a regulatory node (HYPO) that its _authored circuit drops.

DRUG_RESISTANCE.observation: Structurally complete under the incomplete-circuit test, yet UNMAPPED in the failure-class map (model-drift is outside the 9-class taxonomy). The two diagnostics are independent.

HEALTHCARE_COLLAPSE.observation: No REGULATORY_NODES member present. mPFC and rACC are cortical but NOT in the regulatory set (only vmPFC/dlPFC/OFC among PFC nodes qualify); the brake/feedback arm is omitted.

MALPRACTICE_CRISIS.observation: dACC (the hypoactive error monitor itself) supplies the regulatory partner; the circuit is structurally complete even though the FAILURE is the hypoactivity of that very node.

MENTAL_HEALTH_CRISIS.observation: No REGULATORY_NODES member present. The rumination issue authors the DMN driver (mPFC, DMN) with no vmPFC/dlPFC brake and no HIPP feedback — the extinction/inhibition arm is exactly what is missing, consistent with the failure it names.

CHRONIC_DISEASE_LOAD.observation: INVERSE OF FINANCE: the CANONICAL single-node circuit here IS a regulatory node (HYPO[Hyper], the severed homeostatic set-point), but the _authored circuit DROPS HYPO and every other regulatory node -> _authored is INCOMPLETE while canonical-only would PASS. The homeostatic-feedback arm whose failure IS the issue is not authored into the circuit.

CLINICAL_COORDINATION_BREAKDOWN.observation: No REGULATORY_NODES member present (THAL is a gating hub, not in the regulatory set). A pure sensory/relay/DMN circuit with no feedback or inhibitory partner — structurally the diaschisis it describes.

THERAPEUTIC_RELIABILITY_RISK.observation: Structurally complete, yet UNMAPPED in the failure-class map (model-drift outside the taxonomy). Independent diagnostics.

parameter_table._note: Part XV, verbatim. Quantitative substrate for scale-rescaling. Confidence + anchor preserved.

rows.parameter: Gut serotonin fraction of body total

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Medicine mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action / slow-governance separation, or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
